title: Negation commutes with expectation
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f\colon\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$. The uniform expectation of the pointwise negative of $f$ is the negative of its uniform expectation: $\E_x[-f(x)]=-\E_x[f(x)]$.
replaced:
Let $n\in\mathbb N$ and $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$.
Then $\mathbb E[-f]=-\mathbb E[f]$, where $(-f)(x)=-f(x)$ and
$\mathbb E[h]=2^{-n}\sum_{x\in\{0,1\}^n}h(x)$.
